title: Local structure of a ring strict henselization
statement: Let A be a local commutative ring, K a chosen separable closure of its residue field, and C an A-algebra satisfying IsStrictHenselization A K C [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Then C is a local ring, and its maximal ideal equals the ideal generated by the image of the maximal ideal of A under the structural map A → C. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 04GP(2),(4) and 04GW, equivalence of pointed etale algebras and etale residue triples and uniqueness of their colimit

proof.text: Let p be the closed point of Spec A and identify its residue field with the residue field of A. Transport the given K-algebra and separable-closure structures along this field isomorphism. For a pointed etale A-algebra S with map f to K, take q=ker f. The prime q lies over p since f restricted to A is the canonical residue map followed by its embedding in K. Extend the injective map S/q → K to its fraction field by s/t ↦ f(s)/f(t). This gives a residue triple. Conversely compose the residue map of a triple with its specified embedding in K to get a pointed algebra. Uniqueness of fraction-field extension and injectivity of a field map show these constructions are inverse up to the canonical isomorphisms. A morphism in either category is an A-algebra map commuting with the maps to K, so the constructions induce an equivalence of categories preserving the underlying ring diagram.

Apply the triples theorem at p. It supplies a colimit ring T with local-ring structure and structural map rho from A such that maximalIdeal T = (maximalIdeal A).map rho. Regard the underlying ring colimit as an A-algebra colimit: its algebra map from A is given by the common composite from A through each stage. For any cocone of A-algebras the ring-colimit descent is A-linear because it commutes with a stage map and that stage map commutes with A. Transport the cocone along the category equivalence in the preceding step. The colimit in IsStrictHenselization and this transported colimit are uniquely isomorphic as A-algebras. Compose this comparison with the algebra isomorphism furnished by hC to obtain e:T ≃ₐ[A] C.

Transport the local-ring property across e. Since e and its inverse preserve units, the ideal of nonunits of T maps exactly to the ideal of nonunits of C. Thus maximalIdeal C = (maximalIdeal T).map e. Substitute the expression for maximalIdeal T. Functoriality of ideal map and e(rho(a))=algebraMap A C a give the asserted ideal equality.

theorem strictHenselization_local_maximalIdeal
    (A K C : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] (hC : IsStrictHenselization A K C) :
    ∃ (_ : IsLocalRing C),
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C)
